nodes.title: Replay Pack: every selected photo as one set of references
Read me
widgets_values:
## 16. Fantasy cast: ready-made RefCaps
Renders the README's crystal cavern shot from RefCaps you can download, so you can try RefCap before capturing your own: the elf ranger and the dwarf warrior, three views each, the crystal cavern, and both their voices, in one *Replay Pack*.

**Steps**
1. Download the RefCaps from [huggingface.co/AEmotionStudio/H3-RefCap](https://huggingface.co/AEmotionStudio/H3-RefCap) into `ComfyUI/models/refcaps/` and refresh the browser.
2. Download the models this workflow loads, from [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3):
   - `diffusion_models/`: [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (19.5 GB)
   - `text_encoders/`: [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (14.6 GB)
   - `vae/`: [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (2.6 GB) and [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) (577 MB)
   - `loras/`: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.8 GB), the 4-step Lightning LoRA
3. Queue. Each *Select* takes the views the shot needs; press **Pick views...** to see them. The **Label guide** lists which `<Picture i>` and `<Audio j>` each one became.

**The cast** (all 0-based views; a shot takes at most 9 pictures and 3 audio references)
- `elf_ranger`, `dwarf_warrior`, `tiefling_sorceress`, each as `_front` (5 views, -45 to 45 degrees), `_body` (6 full-body views, 0, ±45, ±90 and 180 degrees) and `_turnaround` (24 head views, every 15 degrees), plus `_voice` (one audio reference: `views` = `none`, `audios` = `1`).
- Locations: `fantasy_crystal_cavern_set` and `fantasy_wizard_study_set`, 4 views each (-90, 0, 90 and 180 degrees).

**Swapping in the tiefling:** set *Character 2* to `tiefling_sorceress_front` and *Voice of character 2* to `tiefling_sorceress_voice`, and rewrite her lines in the prompt, e.g. `<Subject 2> is the woman in <Picture 4>, <Picture 5> and <Picture 6>, a tiefling sorceress with lavender skin, golden eyes, long wavy black hair, black ram horns and pointed ears, wearing a deep purple robe embroidered in gold.`

**Cost:** nine pictures and two voices at 960x544 x 158 frames; lower the size and length on the latent for quicker tries.

The characters and places are generated, not real people; the voices were designed with VoxCPM2.

**Settings in these workflows** follow ComfyUI's MiniMax H3 reference-to-video template: the ref2va model with its 4-step Lightning LoRA, 4 steps, `res_multistep` + `simple`, 608x352. For the base model, bypass the *Lightning LoRA* node and use 20 steps. The measurements quoted here ran on a community H3 turbo finetune (shift 6/3, 8 steps) on a 12 GB GPU. Raise the size and length for final renders; the reference tokens ride through every step, so more photos and larger captures cost time.

nodes.title: Prompt guide
widgets_values:
## Writing the prompt
H3's reference mode reads a structured prompt. The photos are labelled in order: `<Picture 1>` ... `<Picture N>`, where N is the number of photos in the RefCap.

```
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>, a white woman in her mid-twenties with dark brown, wavy, shoulder-length hair.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> sits at a sunlit cafe table and smiles at the camera.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the woman's facial identity and hairstyle are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic, full-color cinematic shot with warm daylight.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up shows <Subject 1>, wearing a navy t-shirt, ...

overall_soundscape:
Gentle street ambience.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

**Tips**
- Describe age, gender and hair, and **say the outfit and action you want**. The photos supply the face; the prompt supplies everything else.
- Don't count on a name. The tests never used one.
- More detail in `detailed_description` (camera, lighting, motion, sound) gives better shots. MiniMax's guide suggests 350-500 words for final renders.
- Official format guide: MiniMax-H3 `docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md`.
